title: 文章复盘 · 8题
meta: 2011 英语一 Text 4 · 本篇问题 2 题 + 历史弱项 6 题 · 全部使用迁移语境
footer: 本篇复盘结果只有在你点击“提交结果到 GitHub”并在 GitHub 再点 Submit new issue 后，才会进入后续间隔复习。

questions.q: The committee spent twenty minutes arguing about the font on the warning sign, while the real issue was whether the bridge was safe. They were clearly ___.
o: missing the point
making a point
reaching the point
pointing out

diag.1: make a point 常表示“提出观点/特意强调”，这里强调的是没抓住真正问题。
diag.2: reach the point 需要具体语境，如 reach the point where...，不能表达“没抓住重点”。
diag.3: point out 通常后接宾语，表示“指出”；这里既不合结构也不合语义。

exp.trans: 委员会花了二十分钟争论警示牌的字体，而真正的问题是这座桥是否安全。他们显然没有抓住重点。
exp.structure: 第一句：The committee（主语）+ spent（谓语）+ twenty minutes（宾语）；arguing...说明时间花在何事上。while连接对比；whether the bridge was safe作表语从句。第二句：They（主语）+ were missing（现在进行时谓语）+ the point（宾语）。
exp.other: committee 委员会；warning sign 警示牌；issue 问题/争议点；safe 安全的。
exp.meaning: miss the point = 没抓住重点、没理解关键。point 在这里是“要点/关键”，不是“节点”。
exp.rest: make a point = 提出/强调观点；reach the point = 达到某个阶段/程度；point out = 指出某事。只有 missing the point（没抓住重点）符合他们纠结字体却忽视桥梁安全的语境。

questions.q: Even after the company simplified its procedures, a few managers continued to cling to the old rules. Here, cling to means:
o: 向上攀爬
紧抓着不愿放弃
公开批评
快速修改

exp.trans: 即使公司简化了流程，仍有少数经理继续死守旧规定。
exp.structure: Even after...是让步背景。主干：a few managers（主语）+ continued（谓语）+ to cling to the old rules（补足内容）。cling to的宾语是the old rules。
exp.other: simplify 简化；procedure 流程；continue to do 继续做；old rules 旧规定。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓、依恋、不愿放弃。注意cling不是climb。
exp.rest: climb才是“攀爬”；公开批评是criticize openly；快速修改是revise quickly。这里语境是明知规则已简化仍不愿放弃旧做法。

questions.target: 主语—作用方向 / 因果方向
questions.q: Fitness influencers often make intensive training look effortless, and such images may subtly shape beginners' expectations about exercise. Which statement preserves the direction of influence?
o: Beginners make fitness influencers look effortless.
Images of influencers may influence how beginners think about exercise.
Exercise has little effect on the popularity of influencers.
Beginners' expectations cause influencers to post more images.

exp.trans: 健身博主经常把高强度训练展示得毫不费力，而这些形象可能潜移默化地影响初学者对锻炼的期待。正确改写必须保留“博主形象影响初学者期待”的方向。
exp.structure: 主句1：Fitness influencers + make + intensive training + look effortless。主句2：such images（主语）+ may shape（谓语）+ beginners' expectations（宾语）。作用方向是images → expectations。
exp.other: intensive training 高强度训练；effortless 看起来不费力；subtly 潜移默化地；expectation 期待。
exp.meaning: 阅读中要先锁定施事和受事：谁是影响源，谁是被影响对象。不要因为词都出现过就把方向颠倒。
exp.rest: Beginners make influencers...把方向完全反过来；Exercise has little effect...换成另一个因果关系；expectations cause influencers...同样倒置。

questions.q:
Calling the volunteers' six-month restoration project “not entirely useless” struck the team as faint praise.
哪句改写最准确？
o: The team heard an enthusiastic celebration of the project.
The comment offered only a very weak form of approval.
The comment proved that the project had failed completely.
The team was told that the project had won an award.

exp.trans: 把志愿者历时六个月的修复项目说成“并非完全没有用”，让团队觉得这只是很勉强的赞扬。
exp.structure: Calling the volunteers' six-month restoration project ‘not entirely useless’是整个动名词短语主语；struck是谓语；the team是宾语；as faint praise表示给团队留下何种印象。短语内部call A B：称A为B。
exp.other: restoration 修复；entirely 完全；strike sb as sth 给某人以某种印象；approval 赞许。
exp.meaning: faint praise并非赞扬完全不存在，而是肯定得很有限，甚至暗含保留意见。
exp.rest: enthusiastic celebration表示热情赞颂，力度过强；had failed completely表示彻底失败，把微弱肯定改成全面否定；had won an award表示获奖，原文没有提供获奖事实。

questions.target: 社会暗示 / 满意度推断
questions.skill: 社会信息 ≠ 直接批评
questions.q: A workplace culture repeatedly celebrates employees who stay late, and workers who leave on time are often reminded that “real commitment means sacrifice.” What is most safely suggested?
o: Workers who leave on time are formally punished every day.
The culture may make some workers question whether they are committed enough.
Employees who stay late are always more productive.
Managers ignore workers who leave on time.

exp.trans: 一种职场文化反复赞美加班员工，而准时下班的人经常被提醒“真正的投入意味着牺牲”。最稳妥的推断是：这种文化可能让一些人怀疑自己是否足够投入。
exp.structure: 主句1：A workplace culture + celebrates + employees。who stay late修饰employees。主句2：workers who leave on time + are reminded + that从句。that从句给出被灌输的信息。题目要从这种持续信息推断心理影响，而不是擅自添加处罚事实。
exp.other: workplace culture 职场文化；commitment 投入/忠诚；sacrifice 牺牲；question whether 怀疑是否。
exp.meaning: 反复接收到某种价值信息，最直接支持的是“可能影响自我判断/满意度”，不等于已经遭受正式批评或惩罚。
exp.rest: formally punished every day加入原文没有的正式处罚；always more productive把价值宣传偷换成生产率事实；ignore与“are often reminded”相反。

questions.target: 传统观念 ≠ 实际行为事实
questions.q: A report says: “For years, the conventional wisdom was that renting a small office was safer than buying one.” Which statement is justified?
o: Every small business rented its office for years.
There was a widespread belief that renting was safer.
Buying an office was legally forbidden.
Businesses that bought offices always failed.

exp.trans: 报告说：“多年来，传统观念认为租一间小办公室比买一间更安全。”能够成立的是：曾经存在一种广泛观念，认为租赁更安全。
exp.structure: 主干：the conventional wisdom（主语）+ was（系动词）+ that从句（表语）。that从句说明“观念的内容”，不是统计所有企业实际做了什么。
exp.other: conventional wisdom 传统看法/普遍观念；rent 租；buy 购买；widespread 广泛的。
exp.meaning: belief/rule/considered safer描述的是人们怎么想，不能直接推成“所有人过去都这么做”。
exp.rest: Every把范围扩大成全部企业；legally forbidden把“认为不安全”偷换成法律禁止；always failed把风险判断偷换成必然失败，都是证据过头。

questions.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
questions.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
questions.q:
Applicants who believe that a longer résumé automatically proves greater ability often overlook the value of relevance.
哪组句法判断正确？
o: 主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 proves；主句谓语 believe
主句主语 a longer résumé；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 proves

diag.1: proves 属于 that 宾语从句，不是 who 从句的核心谓语；believe 也不是主句谓语。
diag.2: a longer résumé 是 that 从句内部的主语，不是整句主语。
diag.3: proves 是 that 从句谓语；整句主句谓语是 overlook。

exp.trans: 那些认为简历越长就自然能证明能力越强的申请者，往往忽视了“相关性”的价值。
exp.structure: 原始简单句① Applicants often overlook the value of relevance. ② Applicants believe something. ③ A longer résumé automatically proves greater ability. → ②把 something 换成 that 从句：Applicants believe that... → 再把②变成修饰 Applicants 的 who 定语从句：Applicants who believe that... often overlook...。所以整句主语 Applicants，who 从句谓语 believe，that 从句谓语 proves，主句谓语 overlook。
exp.other: applicant 申请者；résumé 简历；automatically 自然而然地/自动地；relevance 相关性。
exp.meaning: 看到 who 后先划到从句结束，再找主句谓语；who 从句里又可嵌套 that 宾语从句。
exp.rest: 把 that 从句的谓语 proves 误当成外层谓语，或把其中的 a longer résumé 误当成整句主语，都会错过：Applicants 是主句主语，believe 是 who 从句谓语，overlook 是主句谓语。

questions.target: have sth lined up / position lined up
questions.q: Nora resigned from her apartment lease only after she had another place lined up for the following month. Here, had another place lined up means:
o: 把另一个地方排成一条线
已经事先安排好了另一个住处
正在地图上寻找另一个地方
把另一个住处取消了

exp.trans: Nora只有在已经提前安排好下个月的新住处之后，才终止了原来的租约。
exp.structure: 主句：Nora + resigned from/ended her lease（语义上是结束租约）。only after引导时间条件；she had another place lined up表示那时新住处已经提前落实。
exp.other: lease 租约；following month 下个月；resign/leave 退出；place 住处。
exp.meaning: have sth lined up = 已经预先安排好、落实好某事。position/job lined up就是已经找好下一份职位/工作。
exp.rest: line up确实可表示排队/排成一列，但have a place lined up在此是安排义；寻找还未完成不能解释had...lined up；取消则与“先有新住处再退旧租约”的逻辑相反。

point.q:
Even after I explained the joke twice, my brother still missed the point.
missed the point 在这里表示什么？
o: 仍然怀念以前的笑话
仍然没明白笑话的关键
忘记了一个标点符号
没赶上兄弟聚会

exp.trans: 即使我把这个笑话解释了两遍，我弟弟仍然没有明白其中的关键。
exp.structure: 主句：my brother（主语）+ missed（谓语）+ the point（宾语）。after从句：I + explained + the joke；twice修饰explained。even强调即便已经解释过，结果仍如此。
exp.other: joke 笑话；twice 两次；still 仍然；explain 解释。
exp.meaning: miss the point整体表示没领会关键、没明白意思，不能把miss机械地译成怀念。
exp.rest: miss sb可表示想念某人，但miss the point不是这一义项。标点符号一般是punctuation mark，不是这里的point。miss a meeting可表示错过聚会，但原句没有meeting；brother是主语，不是被错过的活动。

point.target: point / there is no point in doing
point.q:
With the last bus already gone, there was no point in waiting at the stop.
point 在这里最接近：
o: 联合会
尖端
分数
意义、用处

exp.trans: 末班车已经开走了，继续在车站等也没有意义。
exp.structure: 主干：there was no point in waiting at the stop，是there be存在句。With the last bus already gone补充原因背景。简单句The last bus was already gone → 去掉was，用with + 名词 + 状态补语压缩。
exp.other: last bus 末班车；already 已经；be gone 已经离开、不在了；bus stop 公交站。
exp.meaning: there is no point in doing sth：做某事没有意义；point不是物理位置上的点。
exp.rest: 联合会常用federation/association，与句意无关。尖端可用the point of a needle，必须是具体物体的尖端。分数可说score three points，但这里不是计分语境。

cling-climb.q: The frightened child ___ tightly to his father's arm as the boat lurched through rough water; when the boat reached the dock, he did not try to ___ over the safety barrier.
o: climbed / cling
clung / climb
clung / climbed
climbed / climb

exp.trans: 船在颠簸水面上摇晃时，受惊的孩子紧紧抓住父亲的手臂；船靠岸后，他没有试图翻过安全护栏。
exp.structure: 第一分句：The frightened child + clung tightly to + his father's arm，tightly修饰clung。第二分句：he + did not try + to climb over + the safety barrier。clung是cling的过去式；climb是不定式原形。
exp.other: frightened 害怕的；tightly 紧紧地；lurch 突然摇晃；rough water 颠簸的水面；reach the dock 到达码头；safety barrier 安全护栏。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓不放；climb over = 翻越/爬过。两个词形相近，但动作和搭配不同。
exp.rest: climbed tightly to his father's arm不符合“紧抓手臂”的语义和搭配；try to climbed over把过去式误放在不定式to后；climbed / climb的第二空虽可成立，但第一空仍不对；cling over不符合固定搭配。只有clung / climb同时满足两处语法和语义。

causal-role-direction.q: Travel advertisements can make remote destinations appear more glamorous than the actual experience, which may influence tourists' expectations. Which paraphrase is correct?
o: Tourists' expectations make advertisements more glamorous.
The actual trip makes the advertisements less realistic.
Advertisements may shape tourists' expectations before they travel.
Tourists make remote destinations appear glamorous to advertisers.

exp.trans: 旅游广告可能让偏远目的地看起来比真实体验更光鲜，这可能影响游客出发前的期待。正确改写是：广告可能塑造游客的期待。
exp.structure: 主句：Travel advertisements（主语）+ can make（谓语）+ remote destinations（宾语）+ appear more glamorous（宾补）。which指代前面的整体现象；which may influence tourists' expectations继续说明这种呈现对游客期待的影响。
exp.other: remote destination 偏远目的地；glamorous 光鲜迷人的；actual experience 实际体验；shape 塑造。
exp.meaning: 原句的因果链是advertisements/presentation → tourists' expectations。主语角色和作用方向不能交换。
exp.rest: 第一项把受影响者变成影响源；第二项讨论actual trip对广告的作用，原文没有；第四项同样把游客变成施事。

faint.q: After a two-hour presentation, Maya said, “Well, at least the slides were readable.” Her remark is best described as:
o: faint praise
earnest approval
open hostility
sufficient evidence

diag.1: earnest approval 是真诚而明确的赞许；“at least...”只给了很弱的一点肯定。
diag.2: 这句话并非直接敌意攻击，而是非常有限、勉强的表扬。
diag.3: evidence 是“证据”，不是评价语气。

exp.trans: 听完一场两小时的演讲后，Maya 说：“嗯，至少幻灯片还看得清。”这句话最适合形容为“勉强的赞扬”。
exp.structure: Maya（主语）+ said（谓语）+ 引语（内容）。问句 Her remark is best described as... 中 is described是被动谓语，不是is加形容词表语。引语主干为the slides were readable；at least限制了肯定的力度。
exp.other: presentation 演讲/展示；readable 易读的；remark 评论；at least 至少。
exp.meaning: faint praise = 勉强的、力度很弱的赞扬。这里 faint 的核心是“微弱的、不强的”。
exp.rest: earnest approval = 真诚、明确的赞成，语气过强；open hostility = 公开敌意，不符合；sufficient evidence = 充分证据，词义类别都不对。只有 faint praise（力度很弱的赞扬）符合 at least 的保留语气。

faint.q:
After years in the sunlight, only a faint line remained on the old map.
这里 faint 最接近哪种意思？
o: 神圣的
突然出现的
隐约的、不清晰的
故意伪造的

exp.trans: 经过多年日晒，旧地图上只剩下一条隐约可见的线。
exp.structure: After years in the sunlight是时间背景。only a faint line（主语）+ remained（不及物谓语）；on the old map是地点状语。
exp.other: sunlight 阳光；remain 留下、仍然存在；line 线条；after years 多年之后。
exp.meaning: faint在这里是微弱、不明显的；与faint praise中赞扬力度很弱具有相近的语义核心。
exp.rest: 神圣的常用holy/sacred；圣人是saint，不是faint。突然出现的可说sudden，重点是发生速度，不是清晰度。伪造的可说forged/fake，描述真伪，原句没有这种信息。

social-message-inference.skill: 被灌输信息 ≠ 被直接批评
social-message-inference.q: A magazine constantly presents home ownership as the clearest sign of adulthood. Renters are repeatedly exposed to stories implying that a “real adult” owns a home. Which inference is best supported?
o: Renters are constantly attacked personally by the magazine.
Renters may be more likely to feel that something is missing from their lives.
The magazine completely ignores renters.
All homeowners are happier than all renters.

exp.trans: 一本杂志不断把拥有住房描述为成年的最明确标志，并反复暗示“真正的成年人”都该有自己的房子。最能支持的推断是：租房者可能更容易觉得自己生活中缺了什么。
exp.structure: 主句：A magazine + presents + home ownership...。第二句：Renters + are exposed to + stories；implying...作后置分词，说明这些故事传达的暗示。推断应沿“信息 → 自我感受”走。
exp.other: home ownership 自有住房；adulthood 成年状态；be exposed to 接触到；imply 暗示。
exp.meaning: 社会信息可能影响人的自我评价或满意度，但这与“被直接人身攻击”不同。
exp.rest: attacked personally把暗示升级成直接攻击；completely ignores与repeatedly exposed相反；all homeowners are happier把价值信息偷换成绝对事实。

viewpoint-fact.target: belief / rule / considered ≠ 行为事实
viewpoint-fact.q: The article states: “The old rule of thumb was that athletes should avoid strength training during the season.” What can you safely conclude?
o: No athlete ever lifted weights during the season.
Coaches once commonly advised against in-season strength training.
Strength training was banned by every sports federation.
Athletes who trained during the season were always injured.

exp.trans: 文章说：“过去的经验法则认为，运动员赛季期间应避免力量训练。”安全的结论是：教练界过去普遍有这种建议。
exp.structure: 主干：The old rule of thumb + was + that从句。that athletes should avoid...说明规则/建议内容。should表达规范性判断，而不是历史行为统计。
exp.other: rule of thumb 经验法则；athlete 运动员；strength training 力量训练；in-season 赛季期间的。
exp.meaning: 规范、建议和传统观念只能支持“有人这样主张/建议”，不能自动推出所有人都遵守。
exp.rest: No athlete ever和every federation都是绝对化扩大；always injured把建议背后的风险偷换成必然结果。

nested.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
nested.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
nested.q:
Residents who discovered that the shared gate was unlocked called the caretaker.
按“主句主语中心词 / who从句谓语 / 主句谓语”的顺序，哪组正确？
o: Residents / discovered / called
the shared gate / discovered / was
Residents / was unlocked / discovered
the caretaker / called / discovered

exp.trans: 发现公共大门没有锁上的住户给管理员打了电话。
exp.structure: 简单句①Residents called the caretaker. ②Residents discovered something. ③The shared gate was unlocked. → 把③接在discovered后：Residents discovered that the shared gate was unlocked. → 把重复的Residents换成who并嵌入①：Residents [who discovered [that the shared gate was unlocked]] called the caretaker。主句完整主语包含who从句，中心词是Residents。
exp.other: resident 住户；shared 共用的；unlocked 没锁上的；caretaker 管理员。
exp.meaning: 发现这件事的是住户；没有锁上的是大门；打电话给管理员的还是住户。三个小句的主语和谓语不能串层。
exp.rest: the shared gate只在that从句中作主语，不能升为主句主语。was unlocked属于that从句，discovered属于who从句；两者都不是主句谓语。the caretaker是called的宾语，不是发现大门未锁的人。

lined-up.q: Before graduating, Priya already had a summer internship lined up at a design studio. This means:
o: She had already secured the internship in advance.
She was still casually browsing internship ads.
The studio had rejected her application.
She planned to arrange desks in a line.

exp.trans: 毕业前，Priya已经提前落实了一份在设计工作室的暑期实习。
exp.structure: 主干：Priya + had + a summer internship lined up。before graduating是时间状语。过去完成/拥有结构强调在毕业这一时间点之前，实习已经安排妥当。
exp.other: graduate 毕业；internship 实习；design studio 设计工作室；secure 获得、落实。
exp.meaning: have sth lined up = 提前安排好/确定好。与still browsing这种“还在找”相反。
exp.rest: still browsing说明尚未落实；rejected表示被拒绝；arrange desks in a line利用line的字面义制造干扰，但与internship语境无关。
